meta.name: Site anatomy
meta.about: What is on disk when you export a HAX site: the five authored parts, the generated files HAXcms rebuilds, and the tools that write each.
meta.kindLabelsNote: Green tiles are yours to edit; gray tiles are generated.

site.desc: A HAXcms site is a folder you can zip and hand to someone. Five things in it are yours; the rest is generated by HAXcms and rebuilt on demand.

f_sitejson.desc: The manifest and navigation tree in JSON Outline Schema. Edit it through the CLI or the outline designer, not by hand.

f_pages.desc: One folder per page holding the authored HTML, written with HAX web components; a markdown alternate may sit beside it.

f_files.desc: Uploads: images, PDFs and media the site uses.

f_theme.desc: theme.css and theme assets for a custom theme layer on top of the chosen theme element.

f_custom.desc: custom.es6.js, the site's own custom build when it has one.

f_registry.desc: Maps every valid tag name to its module path. Built by Ubiquity; never hand-edited.

f_autoload.desc: Finds undefined tags in the DOM, looks them up in wc-registry.json and imports the module, so a page full of custom elements needs no explicit imports.

f_magic.desc: One script tag that loads the autoloader and registry, so any page, HAX site or not, can use HAX elements.

f_llms.desc: A site guide for language models, with links to the machine-readable resources.

f_maps.desc: Crawler and feed maps with absolute URLs rooted at the site's domain and base path.

f_search.desc: The full-text search corpus the site's search and the x/search route use.

f_pwa.desc: Progressive web app files, so a site installs and works offline.

f_wellknown.desc: security.txt, api-catalog and agent-skills/index.json: how security researchers and agents discover the site.

f_static.desc: Static fallbacks that boot the theme and the autoloader.

tours.label: Open a site folder
tours.message: What is on disk when you export a HAX site, which files are yours and which are generated, and what writes each.

scenes.caption: A HAX site is a folder.
Five things in it are yours: site.json, pages, files, theme and custom.
site.json locates every page; the outline designer and the CLI write it.
Everything else is generated and rebuilt, never hand-edited.
The registry, the autoloader and the magic script are how a page full of custom elements just works.
Skeletons ship as these files; HAX11ty and publishing read them; agents discover the site through .well-known.
